name: MultiHedg
summary: MultiHedg is a multi-symbol hedging EA that opens opposing positions across correlated or selected currency pairs to reduce directional risk. It simultaneously manages long and short positions on multiple instruments, aiming to profit from relative price movements rather than absolute market direction. The EA uses a correlation-based approach to select hedging pairs and manages positions with configurable lot sizing and exit rules.
summary_zh: MultiHedg是一个多品种对冲EA，在相关或选定的货币对上开立对冲仓位以降低方向性风险。它同时管理多个品种的多空仓位，旨在从相对价格变动中获利而非绝对市场方向。该EA使用基于相关性的方法选择对冲货币对，并通过可配置的手数和出场规则管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: MultiHedg策略的核心概念是通过在多个相关货币对上同时开立多空对冲仓位来降低单边市场风险。入场条件基于品种间的相关性和价格偏离，当检测到价差扩大到一定程度时开仓对冲。出场条件通常设定为价差回归均值或达到目标利润时平仓，部分版本也包含止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于波动率的手数计算方式，确保对冲两端仓位价值大致匹配。资金管理方面，EA允许配置最大持仓数量和总体风险暴露限制，但部分版本缺少严格的账户级资金管理模块。该策略依赖于品种间相关性的稳定性，一旦相关性断裂可能导致双重亏损风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of MultiHedg is to reduce directional market risk by simultaneously opening long and short positions across multiple correlated currency pairs. Entry conditions are based on inter-instrument correlation and price divergence, opening hedge positions when the spread between correlated pairs widens beyond a threshold. Exit conditions typically trigger when the spread reverts to its mean or when a target profit level is reached, with some versions including stop-loss mechanisms. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or volatility-based lot calculation to ensure roughly balanced position values on both sides of the hedge. Money management allows configuration of maximum position counts and overall risk exposure limits, though some versions lack strict account-level equity management modules. The strategy depends heavily on the stability of inter-instrument correlations, and a correlation breakdown can result in losses on both sides of the hedge simultaneously.

parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Magic number for closing, 0 for all positions

pros: 多品种对冲有效降低单边市场风险，在震荡行情中表现稳健
策略逻辑相对直观，参数可配置性较高便于优化调整
同时交易多个品种有助于分散风险，避免单一品种集中暴露
相关性回归的统计基础具有长期合理性
pros_en: Multi-instrument hedging effectively reduces directional market risk, performing steadily in ranging markets
Strategy logic is relatively intuitive with high parameter configurability for optimization and adjustment
Trading multiple instruments simultaneously helps diversify risk and avoid concentrated single-instrument exposure
The statistical basis of correlation reversion has long-term rationality
cons: 高度依赖品种间相关性的稳定性，相关性断裂时可能双重亏损
对冲仓位占用双倍保证金，资金利用效率较低
缺少动态相关性监控，历史相关性不代表未来表现
在趋势性行情中可能因单边持续偏离而持续浮亏
多品种同时交易增加了滑点和点差成本
cons_en: Heavily dependent on stability of inter-instrument correlations; correlation breakdown can cause double losses
Hedge positions occupy double margin, resulting in lower capital efficiency
Lacks dynamic correlation monitoring; historical correlation does not guarantee future performance
May suffer persistent floating losses in trending markets due to sustained one-sided divergence
Multi-instrument trading increases slippage and spread costs
improvements: 增加动态相关性监控模块，当相关性低于阈值时自动减少或关闭对冲仓位
引入自适应手数调整机制，根据账户净值和波动率动态调整仓位大小
增加相关性断裂时的紧急平仓机制和更严格的账户级风控规则
improvements_en: Add dynamic correlation monitoring module that automatically reduces or closes hedge positions when correlation drops below threshold
Introduce adaptive lot sizing mechanism that dynamically adjusts position size based on account equity and volatility
Add emergency close-out mechanism for correlation breakdown and stricter account-level risk control rules

risk_points: 相关性断裂可能导致对冲两端同时亏损
多品种同时持仓占用大量保证金，极端行情下可能面临爆仓风险
缺少动态相关性监控和自适应调整机制
risk_points_en: Correlation breakdown can cause simultaneous losses on both sides of the hedge
Multi-instrument positions occupy significant margin, risking margin call in extreme market conditions
Lacks dynamic correlation monitoring and adaptive adjustment mechanisms

The EA uses a correlation-based approach to select hedging pairs and manages positions with configurable lot sizing and exit rules.
